title: Friendly market humans: five Meshy T2.5 bases x fitted ordinary wearables, healthy clips (prototype)

status.stage: unapproved prototype derivative (friendly market humans); art / anatomy / deformation / fit not certified
status.licenseClearance: none - evaluation quality does not grant commercial rights; the bases are AI reconstructions (Meshy T2.5) of AI-generated (Codex) concept images

honesty.rig: NEW derivative skeleton (the shared 18-joint naming / hierarchy) and automatic skin weights created by this CPU pipeline (zombie autorig libraries)
honesty.animation: hand-authored procedural HEALTHY clips (tools/asset-pipeline/humans/lib/clips.mjs; same functions for every body, sampled with each body's own joints) - NOT motion capture, NOT the zombie clips
honesty.maps: the Meshy base colour, metallic-roughness and normal maps are KEPT on the Meshy mesh / UVs (re-encoded JPEG, resized only)
honesty.generation: no generation, inference, model download or network service was used by this builder

glb.format: glTF 2.0 binary (KHR_mesh_quantization int8 normals); JPEG textures; per body: 18 prefixed joints, the skinned body, its fitted wearables on the SAME skin, its clips "<body>:<Clip>"; per wearable one shared texture / UV / index set

m1.label: Man, about 40, medium build, trimmed beard

source.provider: Meshy meshy_image_to_3d (ai_model meshy-t2.5, model_type smart-topology, pose_mode a-pose, 2K PBR textures, target 20k triangles)
source.conceptProvider: Codex native image generation (initial concept, approved in the task)

placement.note: scaled to 1.78 m; source faced +Z: no rotation; feet midpoint (bbox centres of soles below 4 cm) moved to origin

facing.method: sole bbox z-centre (lowest 3% of height) vs shin centroid (8-12%): toes extend toward the front

mesh.method: Meshy source mesh kept as the runtime mesh (no simplify / unwrap / bake); skeleton detected on a densified copy

densify.method: per-edge midpoint split (consistent across shared edges, linear position/UV/normal) until every edge <= maxEdge; surface and texture mapping unchanged

legBridgeTrim.method: triangles joining the left and right leg regions lower than 0.05 m under the crotch removed

skinning.method: zombie/lib/autorig.mjs bodySkin (skin.mjs region classification + chain weights + masked Laplacian smoothing)

hit.method: torso: median quarter (width+depth) of skin torso-region rows over Spine..Chest+5cm; head: mean half extents above the neck; limbs: mean measured radii x1.35 (arm) / x1.4 (leg)

sit.method: thighs -102 deg (from -102, raised while the feet could not reach the floor); pelvis height: lowest Hips / Thigh vertex 0.012 m above the floor; knee flexion: lowest Shin / Foot vertex on the floor (bisection, body mesh skinned)

limitations: Automatic approximate skin weights; LBS volume loss at shoulders / elbows / hips in the deeper poses (Sit, Greet).
Procedural (not mocap) clips; no facial rig, no finger or twist bones (hands stay in their A-pose shape).
No cloth simulation: wearables are linear-blend skinned with weights transferred from each body; small gaps or pokes can show in strong poses.
Hidden-side geometry of the Meshy bases is AI-hallucinated; the maps are the Meshy model's own (normal map kept, sampled without tangents).
Unapproved prototype: appearance, anatomy, deformation, performance and licensing not certified.
